about.title: About MFC Football Academy
about.body: Mutharasanallur football club is a professional football training center committed to developing young players through structured coaching programs. We aim to promote football at the grassroots level and nurture student-athletes with discipline, teamwork, and sporting excellence.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be the leading grassroots football development centre in Tamil Nadu — building the next generation of Indian footballers with discipline, skill, and sporting values.
vision.missionBody: To provide structured, age-appropriate coaching that develops every player's technical, tactical, physical, and mental abilities.
